artworks.title: Saint Paul Preaching in Rome
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The illustration depicts a scene set in an ancient city with classical architecture. The main focus is a group of figures in robes and armor, some carrying weapons. The background shows an audience seated, suggesting an important assembly or gathering. The text at the bottom functions as a caption.

artworks.title: Samuel Anointing David
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals in a scene where a person is being anointed. The central figure is kneeling with hands held together in front of them. An elderly figure next to them is pouring liquid onto their head from a horn-shaped vessel. Other figures surround them, some with their hands together or outstretched. The background includes a stone structure on the left and rocky terrain on the right, with additional figures present. In the top left, there are clouds and winds swirling around a man playing a lyre.

artworks.title: David Bringing Presents from His Father to Saul
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring several figures. A central figure is seated on a throne, facing slightly to the left and gesturing with both hands. He has a bearded face, an ornate crown, long flowing hair, and is wearing a richly decorated robe. Surrounding him are standing men in turbans and robes. A shirtless man with a shepherd's staff stands with a loaded donkey. In the background is an architectural structure with columns and additional figures having a conversation.

artworks.title: Jesse Sending David to the Camp
artworks.description: The image shows three men outdoors. In the center, a man is standing holding a staff and a bundle of items. He has curly, shoulder-length hair, a focused expression, and wears a tunic and no shoes. To the left, a man is sitting on a chair wearing a hat and a robe. The third man is seen walking towards tents carrying a bundle and a bag. Various objects are scattered on the ground. The background depicts a pastoral setting with sheep, tents, and people, under an overcast sky with clouds.

artworks.title: David's Brother Relating to Him Goliath's Challenge
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical battle scene with elaborately dressed warriors in armor and helmets, some holding spears and weapons. The background includes tents and more soldiers. The warriors appear focused and ready for conflict, with intricate details on their armor and expressions. The composition is dense, with overlapping figures creating a dynamic sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: David Armed before Saul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient military scene involving soldiers and a seated figure. The image shows armored men with weapons and shields in front of an authoritative figure who is seated on an elevated platform or throne. The seated figure has a beard, points with one hand, and rests the other on the seat. Surrounding him are soldiers with different expressions and postures, some engaged in conversation. Tents with decorative elements and additional figures are seen in the background. The armor, weapons, and tents are intricately detailed, suggesting a focus on historical or mythological themes. The composition is rich with textures and patterns, creating a sense of a bustling military encampment or historical setting.

artworks.title: David Meeting Goliath
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a heavily armored giant and a young figure in an ancient landscape. The giant stands on the left, wearing armor and holding a spear. On the right, a smaller figure stands confidently with a sling. There are soldiers in the background with tents and structures in a rugged terrain. The sky shows clouds and a sun-like phenomenon with concentric circles. The artwork demonstrates detailed linework and printmaking skills.

artworks.title: David Cutting Off Goliath's Head
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battlefield scene. The image shows a detailed composition of a battle, with a central figure raising a sword above their head. At their feet lies a fallen figure in armor, surrounded by soldiers and tents. The background features a landscape with a castle and troops. The scene conveys movement and intensity, capturing a moment in a confrontation. The drawing's line work and shading suggest mastery of form and detail reminiscent of classical and historical imagery.

artworks.title: David with Goliath's Head before Saul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The image shows a group of armored figures, with one central figure holding a large severed head. Around them are various individuals in a tented setting, suggesting a camp or military gathering. Armor, weapons such as spears, and elaborate clothing are evident. The drawing captures intense expressions and dynamic poses, showcasing a moment of triumph as one group presents a vanquished opponent to a seated leader. The intricate detailing and rich use of linework emphasize the grandeur and drama of the event.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Saul and David
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parade or procession with a mounted figure. In the foreground, a royal or authoritative figure is depicted on horseback, adorned in ornate armor and a crown. The horse carries elaborate decorations, including a detailed harness and saddle. Around the central figure, there are people engaged in various activities. Some are playing musical instruments such as a harp and a lyre. Others are holding objects like spears or banners. The background features a gathering of people, some marching or celebrating, flanked by architectural structures like towers and gates.

artworks.title: David before Saul
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical scene. A figure holds a harp, while armored figures and bystanders are present. A seated figure with a spear is at the center. The setting includes classical architectural elements, with detailed textures in the clothing and environment. The scene conveys tension and movement.

artworks.title: Judah  Giving Tamar the Pledge
artworks.artist: Herman Jansz Muller after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with architectural and natural elements. The scene is crafted in a classical or Renaissance style, with detailed line work and hatching creating depth and texture. In the foreground, there's a tree with branches framing the focus. The middle-ground features a city or town with towers and domed buildings spreading towards mountains in the background. The architecture suggests a historical or mythical setting. Latin text is included in the lower portion of the image, adding to its classical aesthetic. Various story-like components offer narrative to the landscape.

artworks.title: Hirah the Adullamite with the Kid
artworks.artist: Herman Jansz Muller after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape with multiple elements. There are two figures conversing near a tree, with a cityscape in the background featuring various buildings, spires, and a prominent tower-like structure. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the architectural features. The style is intricate, with precise lines and texture, resembling an etching or engraving. The image is monochromatic, using different shades of gray. In the background, shepherds can be seen tending to their flocks.

artworks.title: Tamar Brought to Execution
artworks.artist: Herman Jansz Muller after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a narrative scene with various characters in a historical setting. The foreground features a muscular figure engaged in action with a large drape or cloak, while a group of figures in the background watches intently. Architectural structures and detailed line work add depth and texture to the composition, creating a sense of tension and anticipation.

artworks.title: Birth of Pharez and Zara
artworks.artist: Herman Jansz Muller after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring multiple figures and objects. The central focus is a large bed with several individuals engaged in various interactions. Some are on the bed, covered by sheets, while others stand or sit nearby. In the foreground, two figures handle an infant above a basin, surrounded by items like a jug, baskets, and a stand with a scroll or paper. The background shows a curtained area and arched windows suggesting a significant indoor space.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Gideon
artworks.description: This is a painting of a celestial being appearing to a man in a wooded area. The composition depicts an angelic figure with wings standing near the center, overseeing a kneeling man who is attending to a ritual or task with smoke rising up around them. The surroundings are densely wooded, with tall trees forming a canopy over the scene. The foliage and ground are depicted with detailed, cross-hatched lines emphasizing texture and depth. This painting is created in the style of Rembrandt, characterized by the chiaroscuro technique, which is evident in the strong contrasts between the light figures and dark background, creating a dramatic intensity.

artworks.title: Les Filets (The Nets)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside view with serene composition. The viewer is positioned on the riverbank, looking across the water. A horizon line is visible with a sailboat sailing smoothly. Faint outlines of structures can be seen far away. Close to us, there are figures beside fishing nets and wooden crates. The scene is illustrated in a warm sepia tone with intricate textures, precise brushstrokes, detailed foliage, and rippling waters. Light and shadow add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Spring (Printemps)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an elaborate dress standing outdoors. She has one hand on her hip and the other hand holding a fan. Her facial features are delicate with a serene expression, and her hair is styled up with a headpiece or ribbon. The woman is surrounded by tall grass and lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere. The background includes tree branches, adding to the natural setting. The image is detailed and etched, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Summer Evening (Soirée d'été)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a lounge chair. Her body is turned sideways with her head resting against the chair. She has her eyes closed and wavy hair framing her face. She is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with lace details and a scarf around her neck. A corsage with a flower is pinned to her chest. The background shows an outdoor setting with a water body and tree shadows.

artworks.title: Grazing Cow with Two Sheep
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow grazing in a pastoral setting. The scene depicts a cow in the foreground, lowering its head to graze on the grass. It is detailed with defined lines and shading, capturing the texture of the cow’s fur and the landscape. There is a tree on the right side providing shade and additional cows in the background. The sky is filled with thinly drawn clouds and birds in flight.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an old man seated outdoors. He is seen from the waist up, facing forward with a slight turn to the side. His right arm is extended and resting on a book. The man has a bald head with curly hair on the sides and a long beard. His expression is thoughtful, and he appears to be looking upward. He is covered in a cloth, and the setting is rustic with bushes and trees around him. Next to him are wooden crosses and a skull on the ground. The earth below has detailed etching lines. A halo is depicted behind his head.

artworks.title: Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three robed figures in a celestial setting. Two figures are placing a crown on the head of the central figure while an avian form hovers above them. The image is detailed with strong lines, shading, and clouds below.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with one arm raised, holding a long staff. The individual is leaning against the staff, slightly turned to the side with their face looking up. They have a beard and aged facial features, with deep-set eyes and a prominent nose. Their hair is covered with a draped fabric matching their robe. The clothing is a draped garment covering most of their body, leaving the legs exposed from the knee down. They are barefoot on a grassy, stone-filled ground. The background includes stone architectural elements like columns and arches, indicating an outdoor or classic architectural setting.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing upright against a backdrop of architectural elements like columns and an arch. His hair is curly and his face is detailed. He is wearing a toga-like garment with wrappings around his legs, reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek clothing. In one hand, he holds a curved knife. The setting appears to be an ancient ruin, with overgrown plants visible at the top edges. The background is intricately detailed.
